newsitem.title: USA: Starwood completes Conn hotel acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Starwood completes Conn hotel acquisition.

text.p: Starwood Lodging Trust and Starwood Lodging Corp said Thursday they closed the deal whereby Starwood Trust acquired operating and ownership control of the 480-room Stamford Sheraton Hotel in Stamford, Conn., and leased the hotel to Starwood Corp, which has taken over management of the property.

The transaction concludes the acquisition by Starwood Lodging of the first mortgage and other notes secured by the hotel for $10.25 million at a more than 80 percent discount to face value, the company said, adding it first announced the deal Oct. 11, 1996.
Real estate investment trust Starwood Lodging Trust and hotel management company Starwood Lodging Corp trade under the same ticker symbol.

The total cost of acquisition, including the purchase of the mortgage notes, is about $14.6 million, or $30,000 per room, Starwood said. As of April 30, 12-month earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization represented a 19 percent return on the $14.6 million total costs, a spokesman added.
